name: Virag CGI + 3D Master Library
principles: CURRENT BRIEF ONLY: use current composer text and current-turn uploads. Never import an older campaign, festival, offer, headline, product story or topic unless explicitly referenced.
CAMPAIGN CGI FIRST: produce a finished Pinterest/agency-level commercial idea, not a technical demo, plain packshot, generic pedestal render or random effect test.
ONE OUTPUT = ONE STANDALONE STATIC CREATIVE unless another quantity or format is explicitly requested. Never default to collage, contact sheet, storyboard or video.

STRICT PRODUCT ACCURACY: preserve visible product/package geometry, proportions, cap/lid, label placement, logo, artwork, colors and distinctive details. Do not stretch, redesign or recolor the supplied product.
PHYSICAL BELIEVABILITY: even impossible ideas need coherent perspective, weight, support/contact, materials, reflections, shadows, atmospheric depth and environmental lighting.
BRAND FIT OVER TREND: infer palette, mood, material and world-building from the current brand/category. Never force dark, neon, chrome, smoke, sci-fi or luxury styling when it does not fit.
FRESH ART DIRECTION: same preset means the same mechanism, not the same layout. Change composition, hero scale, camera, environment, depth, typography, props and lighting between runs.
FACTUAL SAFETY: never invent ingredients, nutrition, prices, offers, certifications, specifications, medical/performance claims, awards, partnerships, sponsorships or product internals.
DEFAULT SOCIAL FORMAT: if no format is specified, compose as a premium 4:5 campaign creative with mobile-first hierarchy and concise headline space.

commands.label: Concept · Campaign CGI Hero
commands.desc: Flagship product-first CGI campaign with one memorable visual idea.
commands.instruction: Create one flagship static CGI campaign around the exact current product/subject. Build one memorable commercial idea with strong scale, depth, brand-fit environment and 2–3 second hierarchy. Avoid a generic pedestal render.

commands.label: Concept · Product Universe
commands.desc: Layered foreground, midground and background world designed around the product.
commands.instruction: Build a coherent product universe with distinct foreground, midground and background. Derive forms, props, materials and spatial language from the current brand/category. Keep the exact product visually dominant; avoid random floating decoration.

commands.label: Concept · Product as Building
commands.desc: Turn product silhouette into a believable branded structure.
commands.instruction: Create a product-as-architecture campaign: store, kiosk, pavilion, cafe, tower or other brand-fit structure derived from the product silhouette. Preserve recognizable packaging form and branding while integrating realistic architectural scale cues.

commands.label: Concept · Giant Product
commands.desc: Monumental product integrated into a believable real-world scene.
commands.instruction: Scale the exact product to monumental size and integrate it physically into a believable environment using correct perspective, scale cues, contact, reflections and atmospheric depth. Make it feel installed, not pasted in.

commands.label: Concept · Miniature Brand World
commands.desc: Tiny people and environments build a story around the product.
commands.instruction: Create a miniature-world CGI campaign around the exact product using tiny people, architecture, tools, roads, food or category-relevant details. Use believable miniature scale and macro depth of field; every tiny action should support one clear story.

commands.label: Concept · World Inside Product
commands.desc: Reveal an imaginative miniature world inside or through the product form.
commands.instruction: Reveal a symbolic brand world inside, through or within the visual volume of the product/package while preserving its recognizable exterior. Do not invent technical internals; treat the inner world as a campaign metaphor.

commands.label: Concept · Product Landscape
commands.desc: Packaging cues become terrain, roads, cliffs or spatial geography.
commands.instruction: Create a product-landscape campaign where brand/product shapes, colors or packaging cues inspire terrain, paths, cliffs, platforms or environmental forms. Keep the exact hero product visible and readable.

commands.label: Concept · Surreal Scale
commands.desc: Huge and tiny objects interact in a convincing photographic world.
commands.instruction: Build a surreal scale relationship between the exact product and unusually large or tiny people, objects or environments. Use strong perspective and scale cues so the impossible idea remains instantly readable and photographic.

commands.label: Concept · Gravity Defying
commands.desc: Impossible balance or levitation used as an advertising idea.
commands.instruction: Use levitation, suspended elements or impossible balance as a purposeful campaign mechanism around the exact product. Maintain believable weight, shadow logic and spatial choreography; avoid a generic centered floating-product layout.

commands.label: Concept · Hanging Installation
commands.desc: Product suspended from a believable physical support system.
commands.instruction: Suspend the exact product from a crane, cable, facade, gallery rig, transport structure or other believable support. Show convincing tension, attachment points, gravity, scale and shadows. Do not make it look unsupported.

commands.label: Concept · Giant Hand Interaction
commands.desc: Oversized hand places, pulls, opens, lifts or reveals the product.
commands.instruction: Use a large realistic hand or controlled human gesture as the main spatial device around the exact product. Keep anatomy, contact, grip, shadows and scale believable and make the gesture communicate the idea immediately.

commands.label: Concept · Character × Product
commands.desc: Adult human, mascot or generic fictional character interacts with product.
commands.instruction: Create a character-interaction CGI campaign using an appropriate adult human, supplied brand mascot or original generic fictional character interacting with the exact product at exaggerated scale. Keep product branding readable.

commands.label: Concept · Ingredient / Flavor World
commands.desc: Verified ingredient or flavor cues become a rich CGI environment.
commands.instruction: Build an immersive ingredient/flavor world using only ingredients, flavors or sensory cues visible in current references or explicitly supplied. Use realistic material detail and controlled abundance; never invent ingredients or nutrition claims.

commands.label: Concept · Surprise 3D
commands.desc: Automatically choose the strongest unexpected CGI mechanism.
commands.instruction: Infer current product/category/brand cues and choose one unexpected but commercially relevant static CGI mechanism not already implied by the brief. Prioritize a memorable campaign story over technical effects or trendy materials.

commands.label: OOH · Billboard Breakout
commands.desc: Product breaks beyond the billboard frame with convincing depth.
commands.instruction: Build a realistic billboard/display and let the exact product or related visual element cross beyond its frame with correct occlusion, shadows, perspective and environmental interaction. Make it feel like a photographed real-world illusion.

commands.label: OOH · Anamorphic 3D Display
commands.desc: Forced-perspective display illusion from one intended viewpoint.
commands.instruction: Create an anamorphic DOOH-style static concept designed for one ideal viewing angle. Use forced perspective so product and scene appear to extend beyond the screen volume. Preserve product proportions and screen geometry.

commands.label: OOH · Fake OOH / FOOH
commands.desc: Impossible public installation blended into a real place.
commands.instruction: Create a photoreal fake-OOH concept where the exact product or brand-relevant element becomes an impossible public installation. Use real architecture, crowd/traffic scale, weather, reflections and camera perspective to sell the illusion.

commands.label: OOH · Building Facade Takeover
commands.desc: Building skin or architecture transforms into a branded spatial idea.
commands.instruction: Turn a believable building facade into a product/brand-driven spatial takeover using wrapping, protrusion, cut-through, integrated objects or architectural transformation. Keep the effect physically coherent and context-aware.

commands.label: OOH · Transit / Metro Takeover
commands.desc: Train, metro, bus stop or transit architecture becomes the campaign canvas.
commands.instruction: Create a transit CGI takeover using a train, metro, station, platform, bus shelter or transport corridor. Integrate the exact product spatially without implying an official partnership unless supplied.

commands.label: OOH · Airport Takeover
commands.desc: Airport architecture, baggage or travel systems become the campaign idea.
commands.instruction: Create a premium airport CGI takeover using terminal architecture, baggage belts, gates, jet bridges, luggage systems or aircraft-adjacent space as the visual mechanism. Do not imply airline or airport partnership unless supplied.

commands.label: OOH · Mall Activation
commands.desc: Large indoor mall atrium becomes an immersive brand activation.
commands.instruction: Create a mall/atrium CGI activation with believable retail architecture, escalators, balconies, shoppers and display scale. Make the exact product central to an experiential spatial idea rather than a plain screen.

commands.label: OOH · Storefront Takeover
commands.desc: Shop window or storefront turns into a surreal 3D campaign.
commands.instruction: Transform a believable storefront or shop window into a bold CGI campaign using product scale, depth, window breakouts or spatial merchandising. Keep brand/product accuracy and realistic street reflections/contact.

commands.label: OOH · Stadium Takeover
commands.desc: Sports venue becomes a monumental CGI brand moment.
commands.instruction: Create a stadium/arena takeover using field, stands, roof, scoreboard, tunnel or exterior architecture as the visual canvas. Keep the product exact and never imply official league/team sponsorship unless supplied.

commands.label: OOH · Pop-up / Brand Experience
commands.desc: Immersive pop-up or experiential installation built around product.
commands.instruction: Design a plausible experiential brand activation—pop-up, launch installation, interactive centerpiece or public experience—around the exact product. Make it commercially credible, visually bold and tied to current brand cues.

commands.label: Theme · Forest
commands.desc: Premium forest with layered natural depth.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a premium forest using trees, moss, roots, foliage, mist and shafts of light as appropriate. Keep contact and scale believable and make the forest support the brand idea rather than becoming generic green scenery.

commands.label: Theme · Jungle / Tropical
commands.desc: Dense tropical environment with humidity and layered vegetation.
commands.instruction: Use lush layered vegetation, large leaves, humid atmosphere, filtered light and water droplets where appropriate. Maintain strong product visibility and avoid covering important label areas.

commands.label: Theme · Modern City
commands.desc: Contemporary urban architecture and street-scale energy.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a believable modern city using architecture, plazas, traffic, sidewalks or rooftops. Choose urban styling that fits the brand rather than defaulting to Times Square.

commands.label: Theme · Street / Urban
commands.desc: Street-level campaign with authentic local urban detail.
commands.instruction: Use sidewalks, storefronts, walls, crosswalks, street furniture or alleys as brand-appropriate. Keep the result polished and intentional rather than defaulting to random graffiti.

commands.label: Theme · Country / Culture
commands.desc: Country or region-specific environment when explicitly supplied.
commands.instruction: Use the country/region explicitly named in the current request and build accurate high-level architecture, environment and cultural cues without stereotypes. If none is supplied, use a neutral globally readable setting rather than guessing.

commands.label: Theme · Rural / Village
commands.desc: Countryside or village world with grounded environmental detail.
commands.instruction: Use fields, village roads, farms, fences, carts, trees or local architecture where appropriate. Keep the exact product premium and readable while the setting feels believable and lived-in.

commands.label: Theme · Mountain
commands.desc: Epic high-altitude landscape with dramatic depth and scale.
commands.instruction: Use believable mountains, cliffs, valleys, trails, rock and atmospheric haze. Integrate the exact product through a campaign idea rather than simply placing it on a peak.

commands.label: Theme · Desert
commands.desc: Cinematic dunes, rock and heat atmosphere.
commands.instruction: Use wind-shaped sand, dunes, desert rock, long shadows or oasis cues only when relevant. Keep product materials accurate and avoid unnecessary post-apocalyptic styling.

commands.label: Theme · Snow / Ice
commands.desc: Winter environment with realistic frost and cold light.
commands.instruction: Use believable snow accumulation, ice, frost, winter atmosphere and cold light while keeping the product readable. Never imply temperature resistance or performance unless supplied.

commands.label: Theme · Beach / Coast
commands.desc: Bright coast, shoreline or boardwalk environment.
commands.instruction: Use sand, shoreline, cliffs, boardwalk or coastal architecture with believable sun, wind, reflections and contact. Avoid generic vacation-stock styling.

commands.label: Theme · Underwater
commands.desc: Submerged environment with convincing water optics.
commands.instruction: Use realistic caustics, refraction, bubbles, suspended particles and depth falloff while preserving label readability. Never imply waterproofing unless explicitly supplied.

commands.label: Theme · Space / Moon
commands.desc: Premium cosmic world with restrained sci-fi detail.
commands.instruction: Use lunar terrain, planetary scale, stars or orbital architecture only when useful. Keep product exact and avoid generic neon sci-fi clutter.

commands.label: Theme · Industrial / Factory
commands.desc: Engineered machinery and infrastructure world.
commands.instruction: Use machinery, pipes, production lines, engineered structures and metal surfaces as category-appropriate. Keep the environment premium and purposeful rather than dirty by default.

commands.label: Theme · Luxury Interior
commands.desc: High-end spatial design with refined materials.
commands.instruction: Use refined architecture, stone, wood, glass, metal, fabric and controlled lighting as brand-appropriate. Do not automatically make it black-and-gold.

commands.label: Theme · Gym / Fitness
commands.desc: Premium training environment with athletic energy.
commands.instruction: Use believable gym equipment, architecture and training atmosphere while keeping the exact product central. Do not invent strength, recovery or performance claims.

commands.label: Theme · Café / Restaurant
commands.desc: Branded dining or beverage environment.
commands.instruction: Use counters, tables, kitchens, serving spaces or menu architecture as appropriate. Turn the environment into a memorable spatial idea rather than a generic restaurant interior.

commands.label: Trend · Tactile Sensory World
commands.desc: Mixed touchable materials designed to feel physical.
commands.instruction: Build a sensory CGI world using a controlled mix of touchable materials—soft, rough, wet, glossy, grainy, fibrous or translucent—selected to fit the brand. Make material contrast tell the story, not just decorate.

commands.label: Trend · Soft / Inflatable
commands.desc: Puffy soft-body forms with playful physical presence.
commands.instruction: Use premium soft, inflated or cushion-like environmental forms around the exact product. Show believable seams, pressure, folds, weight and soft shadows. Do not deform the locked product unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Trend · Plush / Fuzzy
commands.desc: Soft fuzzy surfaces and plushcore environmental forms.
commands.instruction: Create a plush/fuzzy CGI world with realistic fibers, pile, softness and tactile lighting. Keep exact product materials unchanged unless explicitly requested; use plush as the surrounding visual language.

commands.label: Trend · Glass / Refraction
commands.desc: Transparent glass forms with refined refraction and caustics.
commands.instruction: Build a glass-driven CGI environment with physically plausible thickness, refraction, reflections and subtle caustics. Use glass as storytelling material and keep product materials accurate.

commands.label: Trend · Liquid Chrome / Metal
commands.desc: Reflective metal used as a controlled spatial device.
commands.instruction: Use liquid-metal, chrome or precision-metal forms as a purposeful environmental device with controlled reflections and coherent flow/form. Do not coat the locked product in metal unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Trend · Iridescent / Crystal
commands.desc: Spectral, crystalline and prismatic materials with premium light behavior.
commands.instruction: Use iridescent, pearlescent, crystal or mineral forms with physically plausible angle-dependent color, inclusions and refraction. Keep the effect controlled and do not recolor the exact product.

commands.label: Trend · Clay / Paper Craft
commands.desc: Handmade clay, ceramic, paper or cardboard spatial language.
commands.instruction: Create a warm crafted CGI world using clay, ceramic, folded paper or cardboard with subtle imperfections, edges, folds and handmade character. Preserve exact product accuracy and never invent sustainability claims.

commands.label: Trend · Fabric / Textile
commands.desc: Cloth simulation and textile forms with realistic tension and folds.
commands.instruction: Use brand-fit fabric/textile as a spatial storytelling device with believable drape, tension, weave and folds. Keep key product branding unobstructed and the product unchanged.

commands.label: Trend · 3D Typography
commands.desc: Dimensional headline becomes a major spatial campaign element.
commands.instruction: Use a short supplied or non-factual campaign headline as dimensional type that interacts physically with the exact product through depth, scale, contact, occlusion and lighting. Keep text highly readable.

commands.label: Trend · Hybrid 2D × 3D
commands.desc: Combine clean graphic 2D layers with photoreal CGI depth.
commands.instruction: Create a hybrid 2D/3D campaign mixing graphic planes, illustrations or typographic shapes with photoreal CGI depth. Keep one coherent art direction rather than making a collage.

commands.label: Trend · Surreal Play
commands.desc: Playful absurdity with a clear brand-relevant visual punchline.
commands.instruction: Create a playful surreal CGI idea that is strange, delightful and instantly understandable while still serving the current brand/product. The absurdity must have a visual punchline, not random chaos.

commands.label: Trend · Local + Human
commands.desc: Locally authentic cues and believable human connection when relevant.
commands.instruction: When a location/culture is explicitly supplied, use respectful local material, architecture or craft cues without stereotypes. When people are relevant, center believable sharing, gathering, teamwork or everyday interaction. Never guess a culture that was not supplied.
